title: Battle of Urmia (1604)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Urmia (1604)", at revision 1379886770, opens: "The Battle of Urmia, also Urumiyeh, was fought near Lake Urmia in north-western Iran between the Safavid and Ottoman empires and resulted in a decisive Safavid victory. The Ottomans were fooled into an ambush by the Iranian army where many of them were killed or captured in an encirclement manoeuvre. Over the next three years all of western and northern Iran were recaptured and the Safavids even re-established their suzerainty over their former vassals in the Caucasus." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q18385359, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1605 battle between the Ottoman Empire and Safavid Iran". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
